chunks: From him, from his father, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever washes a deceased person and fulfills the trust concerning him shall be forgiven."
I said, "And how does he fulfill the trust concerning him?" He said, "He does not disclose what he saw."

key_terms.الْأَمَانَةَ: the trust or obligation of confidentiality and faithful conduct
key_terms.غَسَّلَ: performed the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.لَا يُخْبِرُ: he does not inform or disclose

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to fulfill the trust when washing a deceased person in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one who performs the ghusl of a deceased person and preserves the trust placed upon him is granted forgiveness. The trust means concealing anything seen on the body of the deceased, emphasizing dignity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct in dealing with the dead.
